# `yieldInCallArgument`

Suggests yielding into a const before a call instead of passing a yield* directly as a call or new argument in Effect generators

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Category | Style |
| Default severity | `off` |
| Fixable | Yes |
| Effect versions | v3, v4 |
| Diagnostic codes | `TS377171` |
| Language Service name | `yieldInCallArgument` |
| Oxlint name | `effecttsgo/yield-in-call-argument` |

## Preview

```ts
import { Effect } from "effect"

declare const load: Effect.Effect<number>
declare function transform(n: number): string

export const preview = Effect.gen(function*() {
  const result = transform(yield* load)
/**
                           ^^^^^ effecttsgo(yield-in-call-argument): This `yield*` is used as a call argument; yield it into a const first, or map the effect, so running the effect and building the call stay separate steps.
*/
  return result
})
```
